fields.label: Start your request
fields.content:
Request access to medical records

Use this form to request access to medical information held by the practice. You do not need to tell us why you want the information.

We may need to check identity and, if you are applying for someone else, your authority to act for them. We will contact you if we need more information.

Do not use this form for urgent medical help. For urgent medical advice, contact NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

Requesting records for a child or young person aged 11 to 15

Young people may be able to understand and make decisions about access to their health information. We will consider the young person’s wishes, understanding, privacy, safety and best interests before deciding whether information can be shared.

Completing this form does not automatically give access to the young person’s record.

Declaration
fields.content:
Declaration

To protect confidential medical information, we may need to confirm the identity of the patient and, where someone is applying for another person, the identity and authority of the person applying.

Please do not send original documents. We will contact you if we need copies or need you to show documents at the practice.

fields.label: Identification and supporting evidence
fields.content:
Identification and supporting evidence

We may ask for only the evidence needed to process the request, for example:

  • Photo identification, such as a passport or photocard driving licence.
  • Proof of address, such as a recent bank statement, utility bill, council tax statement or official correspondence.
  • For a child, evidence of parental responsibility or legal authority where this is not already clear.
  • For an adult representative, the patient’s signed authority or relevant legal authority, such as a registered Health and Welfare Lasting Power of Attorney, deputyship or court order.

We may also be able to verify identity through information already held in the medical record or through staff who know the patient.
